items.title: Your body in 3D
items.body: Explore → Muscles can now show a 3D body: turn it, zoom in and tap a muscle to see its exercises. Switch 2D / 3D on the map or in Account → Body & Health.

items.title: Help with every measurement
items.body: Tap ? on any measurement to see where the tape goes, with steps and a tip. Or tap Measure with me to be guided through them one by one.

items.title: Pick your Apple Watch home
items.body: Three fun home screens for your Watch: Monkey coach cheers you on, Crown deck flips through your week, Charge & go starts with a press and hold. Change it in Account → Apple Watch or on the Watch.

items.title: Watch screens to match
items.body: Every Watch screen follows your pick: full colour, gradient tiles, or game mode with XP, levels, badges and a monkey victory dance.

items.title: Live progress tiles
items.body: Progress tiles switch between Week, Month and All, show your trend and the change vs last time. Tap a tile for its chart, tap a day in the calendar to open that workout.
